name: QIDI UltraPA-CF25 (PPA-CF25) @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 200 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed kept at the printer profile's 8 mm3/s; the manufacturer's 200 mm/s (4.5 mm3/s) is a print-speed recommendation, not a limit.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page: nozzle 300-340 C, bed 70-80 C (with glue), speed 30-200 mm/s, density 1.23, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 196.9 C, melt 237 C. Comparison guide: 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, hardened 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, annealing 100 C 8 h. Older wiki: fan 20 %, annealing 80-100 C 6-8 h. Store variant label '1000g'.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/ultrapa-cf25-filament
